findings.problem: It says the review engine, action-review engine, and a second vendor are “still to do.” Their corresponding plans are completed: `2026-10-23-review-engine`, `2026-10-26-action-review-engine`, and `2026-11-01-ask-ollama-bridge`. This also contradicts the later current-state entry for the review engine.
findings.suggestion: Replace the stale unfinished-work sentence with the actual remaining limitations, and mention the completed second bridge and engines as appropriate.

findings.problem: It describes `2026-11-01-bridge-contract-version-2` as a proposal, but that decision record is `Accepted` on 2026-11-01.
findings.suggestion: State that the accepted decision establishes contract version 2, rather than describing it as proposed.

findings.problem: The headings use an em dash (`### id — title`), while `docs/roadmaps/README.md` specifies the candidate format as `### <id>: <title>`.
findings.suggestion: Use the documented colon separator, or revise the roadmap convention if both forms are intentionally valid.

summary: The roadmap contains two material stale-status statements and one formatting inconsistency with the roadmap convention.
